gen-dafont-hammerhead-gf-bhutuka-expande: Authoritative from the first word, Hammerhead draws a plain outline with an e that never pinches shut. BhuTuka Expanded One slows the pace to a leisurely walk, its curvy classic serif letters feeling unclamped.
gen-dafont-hammerhead-gf-hepta-slab: A plain, unmodulated outline gives Hammerhead its whole personality. Hepta Slab stretches each word out like a bent paperclip, bookish and dignified, so the pair is strongest where heavy and relaxed meet.
gen-dafont-hammerhead-gf-kiwi-maru: Hammerhead leads with an industrial, unmodulated outline. Its e stays wide open, while Kiwi Maru takes over with generous letterspace and terminals stopping far from the stem, a more traditional, editorial voice.
gen-dafont-hammerhead-gf-padyakke-expand: Hammerhead holds a plain outline and an open e up top, with Padyakke Expanded One below it in wide-mouthed c shapes. Its text serif glyphs drift apart like knots on a slack rope.
gen-dafont-hammerhead-gf-stint-ultra-exp: Authoritative and industrial, Hammerhead sets a plain outline with an e that never looks squeezed shut up top. And Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart from the rest, so a long passage would drift along like pipe cleaners laid in a row.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label keeps each letter alone like a bead on a rod. Epunda Slab brings tall rounded lowercase and a visibly gaping c, which makes the dignity of a classic serif the pair's real strength.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-fauna-one: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label sets each letter apart like beads on a rod. Fauna One follows with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, so a long passage would read low, literary and dignified.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, Glegoo has big counters and curved letters with unclosed mouths. Next to Impact Label's bead-like, high-set letters, the pair's strongest quality is how open the body feels beneath such a heavy head.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s, set beneath Impact Label's pincer-ended c. A long passage would feel refined and tall.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noticia-text: Impact Label's c ends point apart like open pincers, each letter standing alone. Noticia Text answers with big entrances into every curved letter and lowercase bodies filling most of the height, a literary, dignified classic serif.
